# vastdata_tenant_metric_label_values (Resource)



## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "vastdata_tenant_metric_label_values" "example" {
  # The tenant to associate this label value with.
  tenant_id = vastdata_tenant.example.id

  # The metric label (from vastdata_tenant_metric_labels) whose value is set.
  label_id = vastdata_tenant_metric_labels.environment.id

  # The value for this metric label on this tenant.
  value = "production"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `label_id` (Number) The ID of the metric label.
- `tenant_id` (Number) The ID of the tenant that owns this metric label value.
- `value` (String) The value for this metric label.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Timestamp when the metric label value was created.
- `id` (Number) The ID of this resource.
- `label` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--label))
